name: coding-agent-aggregator

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix packages/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run daemon
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/daemon run demo
scripts.mcp:config: npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server --silent && node packages/mcp-server/dist/index.mjs --print-config

author: Wajid Khan
description: Local-first daemon that lets a manager coding agent delegate work to worker agents in isolated git worktrees, with one web/mobile control plane.
